acceptanceCriteria: AICockpit reports explicit mapping states and active context from canonical state.
AgileCockpit distinguishes valid local operation from pending and failed synchronization.
Migration and error states are understandable without inspecting JSON.
component: AICockpit and AgileCockpit presentation and management for the R-04 and R-14 models.
componentsAffected: AICockpit and AgileCockpit presentation and management for the R-04 and R-14 models.
rationale:
Mapping state and active context exist in canonical state but are not surfaced, so operators must read JSON to tell valid local-only operation from a failed synchronization. This task reports both through AICockpit and AgileCockpit, including migration and error states.

Constraint: Human-only workflow authority remains unchanged.
testSteps: CLI contract tests and AgileCockpit model/UI tests.

workItem.title: Expose mapping and active-context state in Cockpit interfaces
